objective_for_doctor:
Age: 59
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve been having severe pain in my chest—both upper and lower chest, in the right and left breast area, and in the epigastric area. It’s sharp, radiates to the posterior chest wall on the left, and it’s very intense (9/10). It started very rapidly (9/10), and it also comes with shortness of breath that’s significant, and I feel my heart beating fast and irregularly with palpitations. The pain is worse when I lie down and better when I sit up.

How long ago did this pain start, and has it been constant since it began or does it come and go?
How long ago did this pain start, and has it been constant since it began or does it come and go?

I don’t know. But it started very rapidly (9/10) and the pain is very intense (9/10). It’s sharp, in the lower and upper chest and breast areas (right and left), and in the epigastric area, with radiation to the posterior chest wall on the left. It’s worse when lying down and better when sitting up, and I also have significant shortness of breath and palpitations with a racing, irregular heartbeat.
Do you have fever, cough, recent viral illness, or pain that gets worse when taking a deep breath?
Yes, I recently had a viral infection.
Have you had any leg swelling or pain, recent long travel/immobility, surgery, cancer, or coughing up blood?
Any history of heart disease, pericarditis, atrial fibrillation, blood clots, or are you pregnant/postpartum?
[DDX] Acute pericarditis, myopericarditis, pulmonary embolism, acute coronary syndrome, aortic dissection
